user.title: Set up AWTRIX Blueprint Migrator
user.description: Select the new AWTRIX NG device that should be used by migrated automations by default.

data_description.target_awtrix_device: This device replaces the legacy AWTRIX device in migrated automations. It can still be overridden when running the migration action.
data_description.name_prefix: Default: [NG] . Example: 'Outdoor temperature' becomes '[NG] Outdoor temperature'.
